stages.name: Requirements
stages.entryQuestion: Before designing a cloud drive, what scope and scale assumptions would you clarify?
stages.objective: Agree on product behavior, measurable quality targets and the stated exercise workload.

completionCriteria.name: Functional scope
completionCriteria.guidance: Include folders, resumable upload, version history, device sync and permission checks; distinguish binary-file conflicts from collaborative editing.

completionCriteria.name: Quality targets
completionCriteria.guidance: Prefer no silent data loss and access-controlled metadata; make synchronization freshness explicit.

completionCriteria.name: Capacity estimates
completionCriteria.guidance: Use the fictional baseline or state a justified alternative; derive average and peak rates and distinguish payload bytes from replication and indexes.

stages.name: High Level Design
stages.entryQuestion: Walk me through the metadata path and the file-byte path separately.
stages.objective: Keep large file bytes out of the metadata database and API hot path.

completionCriteria.name: Metadata ownership
completionCriteria.guidance: Use a metadata service for file identity, folders, versions and access checks.

completionCriteria.name: Content path
completionCriteria.guidance: Use durable object storage and scoped upload/download authorization; direct client transfer is valid.

completionCriteria.name: Change propagation
completionCriteria.guidance: Use a durable change feed and a notification hint so devices can recover missed events.

stages.name: Core Flow
stages.entryQuestion: How does an interrupted upload become one committed file version and synchronize safely?
stages.objective: Cover resumable upload and version-checked synchronization.

completionCriteria.name: Resumable transfer
completionCriteria.guidance: Track upload session parts and checksums, retry missing chunks and bound session lifetime.

completionCriteria.name: Atomic publication
completionCriteria.guidance: Publish a metadata version only after referenced content is durable; retried completion must be idempotent.

completionCriteria.name: Version conflict
completionCriteria.guidance: Use an expected version or equivalent concurrency check; preserve a conflicting copy rather than silently overwriting a binary file.

completionCriteria.name: Optional deduplication
completionCriteria.guidance: Deduplicate within an authorized tenant or user boundary, if included; avoid revealing another user's content existence.

stages.name: Data Model
stages.entryQuestion: How would you model folders, versions, access permissions and the sync cursor?
stages.objective: Define metadata keys and the access paths needed for file listing and sync.

completionCriteria.name: File metadata
completionCriteria.guidance: Model stable file IDs, parent folder, owner, current version and blob/chunk references.

completionCriteria.name: Access control records
completionCriteria.guidance: Represent sharing grants and check permission on metadata and content authorization.

completionCriteria.name: Change history
completionCriteria.guidance: Persist ordered changes and tombstones with per-device cursors; a folder listing index must not require scanning all files.

stages.name: Reliability
stages.entryQuestion: How do offline devices recover, and what happens when a shared file is deleted or access is revoked?
stages.objective: Keep content, sync recovery and authorization correct through failures.

completionCriteria.name: Missed changes
completionCriteria.guidance: Replay changes after a cursor, detect a cursor older than retention and perform a bounded resync.

completionCriteria.name: Content recovery
completionCriteria.guidance: Verify checksums, handle orphan chunks and retry failed object transfers without exposing partial files.

completionCriteria.name: Revocation safety
completionCriteria.guidance: Bound signed-URL lifetimes and invalidate permission caches; explain the allowed access window.

stages.name: Scaling
stages.entryQuestion: What capacity and partitioning plan supports the stated metadata and file traffic?
stages.objective: Size bytes separately from metadata requests and partition by ownership.

completionCriteria.name: Byte budget
completionCriteria.guidance: Estimate 10.49 TB/day of logical uploads and a 30-day new-upload cohort of about 314.57 TB before copies and versions.

completionCriteria.name: Partitioning
completionCriteria.guidance: Partition metadata by tenant or ownership boundary and explain shared-folder hotspots.

completionCriteria.name: Distribution
completionCriteria.guidance: Use object-store multipart transfer and authorized CDN downloads; bound concurrent chunks and retry storms.

stages.name: Tradeoffs
stages.entryQuestion: How would you choose consistency, conflict resolution and deduplication boundaries?
stages.objective: Explain the consequences for user data and sharing.

completionCriteria.name: Metadata consistency
completionCriteria.guidance: Compare conditional strong metadata writes with eventual notifications; do not require global strong consistency for all file bytes.

completionCriteria.name: Conflict tradeoff
completionCriteria.guidance: Compare conflict copies with last-writer-wins and explain why binary merges are not generally safe.

completionCriteria.name: Deduplication tradeoff
completionCriteria.guidance: Balance storage savings with access isolation, hashing cost and garbage collection.
